descriptors.definition: DMAIC is a reactive problem-solving method used to review existing processes, fix issues, and increase capability. In contrast, DMADV is a proactive development framework emphasizing the design of new products and processes to expand capacity.
exclusion: Generic quality control models without defined improvement steps
nearby_distinctions: DMAIC focuses on rectifying current operational bottlenecks whereas DMADV constructs entirely new operational structures.

descriptors.definition: Six Sigma has several operational constraints including an exclusive focus on quality, difficulty handling intangible results, and a need for substantial infrastructure investment. Furthermore, it can be overly complicated for certain tasks and does not apply universally to all products or processes.
inclusion: Constraints associated with Six Sigma implementation
Barriers in translating theoretical Six Sigma concepts
exclusion: Benefits of Lean Six Sigma methodologies
nearby_distinctions: Focuses on inherent methodological constraints rather than execution advantages.

descriptors.definition: Lean Six Sigma combines Lean principles and Six Sigma practices to achieve superior operational speed and effectiveness. This integrated approach allows organizations to maximize profits, minimize costs, and better satisfy customer requirements.
inclusion: Combination of Lean and Six Sigma techniques
exclusion: Implementing Lean or Six Sigma strictly in isolation without synergy
nearby_distinctions: Combines waste reduction from Lean with variation reduction from Six Sigma instead of applying either independently.

descriptors.definition: Process innovation involves implementing new or significantly improved production and delivery methods, encompassing major changes in techniques, equipment, or software. Routine modifications like simple capital replacements, customization, or factor price adjustments are excluded from this definition.
inclusion: Production enhancements through new technology or equipment
Delivery and supply chain software solutions
Support services innovations like purchasing or maintenance
exclusion: Changes resulting purely from factor price variations
nearby_distinctions: Distinct from Business Process Re-engineering which amends existing processes, whereas process innovation implements new methods.
